acceptanceCriteria: A symlink or gitlink row either carries no handle or its handle expands to a named refusal that says why, covered by a test.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent review of PR #85 (V1-0023, evidence summary views). context_summary.go:145 emits a cv1 handle for a symlink row; --expand refuses it with invalid-handle.
title: context: summary emits handles for symlink rows that `--expand` can never open
